occurrences.englishText: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed.
Terror and dread falls on them.
In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak.
The wicked walk on every side,
from the wicked who oppress me,
Into your hand I commend my spirit.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go.
Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness,
Because of your temple at Jerusalem,
Look on my right, and see;
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning,
the people which I formed for myself,
Then he sweeps by like the wind, and goes on. He is indeed guilty, whose strength is his god.”
